subject: integration
name: Orivon test library: add
summary: Test fixture: a 41-byte WebAssembly module with no imports and one export, add(i32, i32) -> i32, the sum of its arguments. Its bytes are written out in full beside it and pinned by this hash, so what runs is what anyone can read. It holds no key and no state, makes no connection and reads nothing an outside party could change. Level 4 with privacy because nothing in it can be lied about or can show the person. Judged here by its publisher.
